body:
_Verify that the runtime environment is not susceptible to buffer overflows, or that security controls prevent buffer overflows._

Environment implies: .NET or JVM or PHP or Ruby and everything else. Realistically speaking, an ASVS assessor is not going to spend 6+ month looking for an 0-day, at expense of other controls. They will either do this control a disservice, providing false sense of security coverage; or ignore it entirely. 

I would suggest adding this under 'known' vulnerabilities, managed through vulnerability management programme, rather than suggesting a broad swooping statement, asking something that's pretty much impossible in this context.

comments.body: I am just dropping this. This is covered by "keep your third party components up to date".
